questions.question: In Nathan's story to King David about a rich man and a poor man, what did the rich man prepare for his guest?

answers.text: A calf from his own herd

questions.question: After telling King David a story about a rich man who took a poor man's lamb, what did the prophet Nathan say to David?

answers.text: That man lives in your city

questions.question: When the prophet Nathan showed King David his wrongdoing, what did David say to Nathan?

answers.text: I have sinned against the LORD
I have done nothing in secret
I have kept the LORD's command

questions.question: Why did King David fast and weep while his baby son was sick?

answers.text: He hoped the LORD might let the child live
Nathan had told him to do it
It was the custom for a king
